typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	Dw_Run_Key as integer (),
	G_Run_End_DT as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		IOGateNo as string,
		IOGateName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT IOGateNo, IOGateName FROM         IOData  where iogatename not like \'%[?????????????]%\' and iogatename like \'%BW-F%\' or iogatename like \'%GL-F%\' or iogatename like \'%GE-F%\' or iogatename like \'%AP-%\'',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCIODATA	source(output(
		Gate_No as string,
		Gate_Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT     Gate_No, Gate_Name FROM         dbo.DIM_GATE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> LKPIODATALKPTABLE
OLESRCIODATA derive(Dw_Run_Key = $Dw_Run_Key,
		Dw_Create_Dt = $G_Run_End_DT,
		IsMainGate = iif(locate('MAIN', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0, true(), false()),
		Facility = iif(iif(iif(locate('GE-', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0, 'BitWise Genesis', locate('GL-', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0), 'BitWise Globus', locate('AP-', upper(IOGateName), 1) > 0), 'BitWise Apex', 'BitWise World')) ~> DERIODATA
DERIODATA,LKPIODATALKPTABLE lookup(IOGateNo == Gate_No,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> LKPIODATA
LKPIODATA filter(!isMatch()) ~> LKPIODATA0
LKPIODATA0 sink(input(
		DW_Create_Dt as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Gate_No as string,
		Gate_Name as string,
		Facility as string,
		DW_Run_Key as integer,
		IsMainGate as boolean
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DW_Create_Dt = Dw_Create_Dt,
		Gate_No = IOGateNo,
		Gate_Name = IOGateName,
		Facility,
		DW_Run_Key = Dw_Run_Key,
		IsMainGate)) ~> OLEDSTDIMGATE
